scripts.seed:reset: wrangler d1 execute my-first-worker-db --local --command "DELETE FROM users WHERE role = 'pegawai'" -y && npm run seed
scripts.seed:reset:remote: wrangler d1 execute my-first-worker-db --remote --command "DELETE FROM users WHERE role = 'pegawai'" -y && npm run seed:remote
scripts.r2:cors: wrangler r2 bucket cors set my-first-worker-images --file r2-cors.json
scripts.r2:cors:dev: wrangler r2 bucket cors set my-first-worker-images-dev --file r2-cors.json
